about: The song facts box's edge cases and races on his LIVE dev app (LISTENERS.md §8.11). Made by song-box-edges.mjs; edit that, not this.
pass: Every shot ok: each probe's `expect` holds (the runner fails a shot on a mismatch and names it). Read the snaps of edge-grown-skins (5 skins), edge-midi-fold and edge-a-then-b.
run: node docs/ops/checks/song-box-edges.mjs && node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/song-box-edges.json --noise 80   (dev app running, on screen, Max, the Library or Search in slot d, and in Midi in the right slot; ask other sessions first)

shots.about: Race: Last.fm answers 2.5 s late; the user leaves the song page first. The late answer must not draw on the list, and nothing throws.

steps.name: left early

shots.about: Race: song A's answer is late; the user goes back and opens song B. B's page shows B's box, never A's.

steps.name: B's box

shots.about: The row off: no box and no lastfm_listeners call from the song page.

steps.name: off

shots.about: The row turned on while a song page is open (Settings, Compass or the agent). The box should come.

steps.name: on while open

shots.about: Last.fm fails: no box, no error toast, the page works. Back and open again: the box comes (a failure is not kept).

steps.name: failed
retried

shots.about: Presentation mode open, then the row goes off (Settings, the agent). The view should close, not freeze.

steps.name: presenting
after off

shots.about: Presentation mode open, then Ctrl+Space and Esc: the Compass closes and the view stays; a second Esc closes the view and keeps the song page.

steps.name: compass closed
view closed

shots.about: The box on a grown card (beside the cover) in every skin: seen, and nothing overflows the box.

steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const w = document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] .artist-info-wrap'); const b = w?.querySelector('.artist-info'); const tags = [...(w?.querySelectorAll('.artist-info__tag') ?? [])]; return { box: !!b, fits: !!b && b.scrollWidth <= b.clientWidth + 1, tagsFit: tags.every((t) => t.getBoundingClientRect().right <= b.getBoundingClientRect().right + 1), beside: !!w && w.getBoundingClientRect().left > document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] .lib-hero__main')?.getBoundingClientRect().left + 40 }; })())
steps.name: grown box
